policy: Source-first scientific ownership: verified external-only biological inputs, including cohort selection, training, labels and derived inputs, belong to FD. Any direct or transitive dependency on project GBIF flora or integrated trait data belongs to island regardless of estimand. Unknown ancestry is quarantined. Outcome-blind geography and unfitted generic methods are neutral. Frozen island GloPL H3 is an explicit supporting-evidence exception.
scope_limit: No protected raw rows or credentials copied. No independent replication inferred from shared inputs or merely distinct publisher files. Archived scripts are not activated workflows. Path allowlist and marker screen do not certify full ancestry; require explicit source and cohort dependency review before promotion. Prior theme-first review entries retained only as provenance.
shared_db_research_policy: Read-only historical provenance of island-owned shared-source results. Do not activate these scripts or use these data/aggregates as inputs to FD research. Historical theme-first review fields are not active ownership permissions.
